name: Clanker Spanker
shortDescription: macOS app that watches your GitHub pull requests and has Claude or Codex fix failing CI and review comments until they're mergeable.
description:
Clanker Spanker is a Tauri desktop app for the round trip between "PR opened" and "PR mergeable". It lists your open pull requests and, for the ones you put on watch, runs a loop: check CI, fetch the unresolved review threads, and hand each blocker to the AI provider you picked to fix.

Highlights:
- A card grid of open PRs with CI status, review status, labels and comment counts.
- A monitor loop per PR that reads CI failure logs and review threads and invokes Claude Code or Codex in a local clone of the repo to push fixes.
- Live terminal output, progress bars and iteration counters while it works; merged PRs stay until dismissed and monitor history is kept.
